sentences.ar: بعد شهور، إجت محاكمة ماف بوتر.
sentences.en: After months, Muff Potter’s trial came.
Everyone was certain he was the killer.
Tom did not sleep for three nights.

sentences.ar: بالآخر، راح عالمحامي وحكى له كل إشي.
sentences.en: In the end, he went to the lawyer and told him everything.
At the court, the lawyer called him and questioned him.
Tom told what he had seen in the graveyard.
Joe jumped from the window and fled.
